resources.string: Every phone becomes a listening sensor
Ready for rescue wake-up. If rescuers search nearby, this phone wakes up and helps them listen, even with the app closed. Uses almost no battery.
Almost ready. For the rescue wake-up to work, Hush must be allowed to run in the background. Tap the button below and choose Allow.
Notifications are off for Hush, so a rescue alert would not show. Turn them on in Settings › Apps › Hush › Notifications.
Full-screen alerts are off for Hush, so a woken phone shows a small notification instead of the red rescue screen. Allow full-screen notifications for Hush in Settings.
Rescuers are nearby! Your phone is active as a rescue sensor. Tap 3 times or shout if you can hear this.

Your phone is now a rescue sensor.

TAP 3 TIMES on the phone
or SHOUT
if you can hear this.
Listening… rescuers can hear where you are.
Could not start listening. Open Hush.
Open Hush once to allow the microphone.
Hush needs the microphone and nearby-devices permissions. Tap a role again to allow them.
Waiting for knocking: the arrow points at the phone that hears it loudest
Not yet aligned to north. Point the top of this phone at a sensor and tap its Align button (best with two sensors).
Place Sensor %1$s on the map first
HERE · the knocking is loudest at this phone
Arrow: waiting for the commander to locate knocking
Arrow: this phone is not on the map yet (run ranging)
→ SOURCE%1$s · north not set (Align on the commander)
→ KNOCKING · %1$d knocks · left or right? turn the phone to confirm
" · felt through the table: put cloth under the phone"
→ CROSSING · ~%1$.1f m ±%2$.1f · the arrows of %3$d phones cross here
→ KNOCKING · fused from %1$s · confidence %2$d%% · turn a phone to firm up
→ KNOCKING · heard here: %1$d knocks · left/right from %2$s
" · same direction as the phones that hear it (Place the phones on the map to point at the spot)"
→ KNOCK · %1$.1f m ±%2$.1f · located by timing across all phones (%3$d knocks)
Knock located %1$.1f m away (±%2$.1f) · tap SYNC COMPASS with the phones parallel to orient the map
ACCEL jolts %1$d max %2$.2f shake %3$.2f m/s²\nonsets in 8 s: %4$d rejected (not a knock): %5$d
Listening…\nthe screen turns a colour and the phone buzzes when it hears something
Tap anywhere to stop the buzzing
Switch a sound off if it keeps firing wrongly. TEST shows its colour and buzzes its pattern so you learn to tell them apart.
High sensitivity (more alerts, more false ones)
some sound · %1$d dB above the room
VERY LOUD · %1$d dB above the room (TV? tap running?)
The phone writes down what people say, using its own speech recogniser (offline when the English pack is installed). While captions run, the sound alerts pause: one microphone user at a time.
type, the phone says it out loud

resources.string: Flash the camera light with alerts
Night mode · light for every alert, screen stays lit longer
Android can also flash the screen or light for every notification: open Accessibility settings
Your doorbell, your microwave, the water heater: play the sound three times and the phone learns it (no recording is kept, only what the model made of it).
Give it a name, press START, then make the sound 3 times within 30 s (ring the bell, run the microwave timer…).
Listening for the cooker · a whistle is loud, steady and tonal (a kettle counts too)
%1$d WHISTLES · DONE · turn the stove off
no whistle for 15 min: check the cooker
Find a ticking, dripping, beeping or knocking noise by walking · put the phone on cloth or hold it flat
→ NOISE from here · %1$d knocks · left or right? turn the phone
Waiting for the noise to repeat…
Stand where you hear it. The phone is listening for it to repeat.
Stand still so the arrow can settle.
Hold on… %1$d knocks heard here, still for %2$d s
Marked. Walk 2 m to the side and stand still again.
Left or right is not settled: turn around once, or walk to a third spot.
Follow the arrow: about %1$.1f m. Stand still again for a better fix.
warmer · %1$.0f dB louder than at the last mark
colder · %1$.0f dB quieter than at the last mark
about as loud as at the last mark
Map tools are on the commander
Knock near the phones. The phone that hears it loudest appears here. Works best with the phones 1.5 m or more apart, on cloth.
Leads the search. Shows which phone is closest to the sound.
Listens and reports to the commander. Use on every other phone.
Dots are phones, placed by inaudible chirps. Green is the closest phone; the red circle is where the sound is.
Counts quieter knocks and reports warmer or colder sooner.
Asks everyone to stay silent for 20 seconds while all phones listen. Hold the button to run it with no sensors connected.
Sends a 30-second Bluetooth call that wakes phones with Hush installed, even when their app is closed.
Pointing becomes available once the phone positions are measured.
Hold this phone so its top faces another phone, then tap that phone\'s button. Do two phones to settle left and right.
This phone is getting closer to the sound. Keep going this way.
This phone is moving away from the sound. Turn back.
Carry this phone while someone knocks. It will say warmer or colder.
